compose_config: compose a Hydra configuration from a config name and CLI overrides for run or multirun mode
run_single_job: run a single Hydra job with a task function, config name, and command-line overrides
run_multirun: run a Hydra multirun sweep using a sweeper plugin with task function and config overrides
show_config: show the composed configuration as YAML output with optional package selection and resolve flags
get_help: get formatted help text with flags, config groups, and resolved config using a template
